sources.title: Cloudflare: Clef + Clef-flash decision models (Oct 1)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: Cloudflare released Clef + Clef-flash Oct 1 (exact 15:34:02Z): first Cloudflare-trained open-source decision models on Workers AI; Apache-2.0 weights on HF; Jev-API compatible; RL fine-tuning platform (FDE now, self-serve later).
claims.context: Cloudflare launch blog Oct 1 + changelog mirror, full bodies read; JSON-LD datePublished 2026-10-01T15:34:02Z exact.

claims.text: Qwen torso (27B Clef / 9B flash), prefill-only pass, parallel schema-choice scoring (non-autoregressive); 64K context (vs Jev 32K); vision encoder (images) unlike text-only Jev; typed noul/choice/score + reliability scores.
claims.context: Vendor architecture description; base IDs cross-checked with Workers AI docs.

claims.text: Workers AI binding/REST/Gateway; $0.24 (Clef) / $0.09 (flash) per 1M input tokens, no output price; 10K neurons/day free.

Jev Decision Index lead claimed (live demo); BFCL 98.47/98.76, BANKING77 94.20, CLINC150+OOS 97.43/66.77, When2Call Jev wins 80.97; Typesafe WorkflowEvals 3/4; latency 209.3/38.8ms vs Jev 524.1ms (edge GPUs).
claims.context: Vendor-run, attribution required; index is vendor-hosted.

claims.text: Oct 9 Clef-omni (30B MoE audio/video) + flash price/context changes are POST-WINDOW and must not leak into W40 figures.

limitations.text: Jev Decision Index is vendor-hosted, not independent reproduction.
